title: Add release team marine_msgs
author: rolker
body:
* Name of the new release team: marine_msgs
* Release repositories to add:
  <!--
  Before release repositories are created, repositories and packages should be submitted to the official rosdistro repository https://github.com/ros/rosdistro for naming review.
  The ros/rosdistro source entry link must be included for each repository.
  Guidelines for package naming are describe in REP-144: https://www.ros.org/reps/rep-0144.html

  If there are any existing release repositories which should have their contents imported into the ros2-gbp organization, list and link to them here.
  Leave the checkbox _unchecked_. The ros2-gbp administrator will check the box when they have completed the repository import.
  -->
  * [https://github.com/apl-ocean-engineering/marine_msgs/tree/ros2](https://github.com/apl-ocean-engineering/marine_msgs/tree/ros2)
    * [ros/rosdistro source entry](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/blob/506bceb93c6570fafd9fc3f4762d53e07b9add5f/noetic/distribution.yaml#L5441)
    * [ ] There is an existing release repository which should be imported: <RELEASE REPOSITORY URL>

* Team members
  * [@rolker](https://github.com/apl-ocean-engineering/marine_msgs/blob/59de95d3f2179bdb2a62aa581b487b9b412f3ca9/marine_acoustic_msgs/package.xml#L10)
  * [@lauralindzey](https://github.com/apl-ocean-engineering/marine_msgs/blob/59de95d3f2179bdb2a62aa581b487b9b412f3ca9/marine_acoustic_msgs/package.xml#L9)

Please note that the rosdistro source entry is for noetic and points to a different branch of the same repo. My PR for a rolling source entry was closed without merging due to Ubuntu 24.04 migration: https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/pull/40014
